seriesTitle: The Law According to Lidia Poët

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: When a ballerina turns up dead, her alleged stalker is accused of murder. Desperate, the suspect's mother turns to Italy's first female lawyer for help.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Much to Enrico's chagrin, Lidia agrees to defend an anarchist accused of murder. But the scandal goes deeper than she expected and lands her in trouble.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Lidia and Enrico discover some family secrets when, in an opioid haze, a man from Lidia's past confesses to patricide in her childhood home.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: A woman very similar to Lidia — educated, underestimated, scorned — is on trial. Lidia wants to represent her, but is she too invested to see the truth?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: After a seance at a wild party, a wealthy businessman mysteriously expires, and the most likely suspect has been locked in an asylum for years.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Lidia uncovers a conspiracy and faces a choice: Should she stay and make her way in a place that doesn't want her, or seek her fortune elsewhere?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: Lidia is determined to keep fighting for equality. When a friend is murdered and found with two cryptic notes in his pocket, she teams up with Jacopo.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: As Lidia investigates a mysterious poisoning at a prestigious boarding school, Jacopo digs deeper into their friend's death and Marianna uncovers a lie.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Enrico remains doubtful about running for Parliament while Prosecutor Fourneau and Lidia struggle to connect the victims of a series of brutal murders.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: An unexpected wedding is disrupted by an unexpected death. As Lidia looks to get to the bottom of it, Enrico prepares a very important speech.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Despite Lidia's conflicted feelings for Fourneau, the murder of a prison guard forces them to collaborate again, as Jacopo edges closer to finding Nitti.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: In the wake of a shooting, Fourneau takes over the Nitti investigation. Enrico receives an eminent guest, while Lidia and Jacopo race against the clock.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: The arrival of an old friend with a desperate plea shakes Lidia's relationships and beliefs as she investigates a mysterious death at the circus.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: As Lidia and Fourneau land on opposing sides of a case that hits close to home, Enrico aids a painter whose alibi for a murder hints at a larger scandal.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Jacopo volunteers to help Lidia solve a boxer's murder after Fourneau uncovers a hole in Grazia's story, forcing Enrico to frantically pivot his defense.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: A key witness misses his court date, leading Lidia to discover he's facing a shocking charge of his own. Consuelo begins to question Jacopo's love.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: The press speculates about Lidia's tryst with Fourneau, pushing Enrico to distance himself from his sister as Jacopo digs into Fontana's military career.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: While teaming up to search Fontana's estate, Lidia and Jacopo unearth a vital clue they hope will alter the outcome of Grazia's landmark case.
